en: A vintage, colorized postcard image depicting an ornately decorated corner building with a domed roof in a European architectural style, likely late 19th or early 20th century. The street is quiet and empty, with another notable building featuring a red-roofed clock or bell tower further down the street. The postcard contains printed text in red in the upper corners.
